newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain June budget deficit at one pct/GDP - report.
newsitem.headline: Spain June budget deficit at one pct/GDP - report.

text.p: Spain's accumulated budget deficit on a national acount basis through June was slightly more than one percent of gross domestic product, Budget Secretary Jose Folgado told a conference in Santander, according to the Europa Press agency.
This represents a fall of more than 20 percent year-on-year, Folgado said.
In May, the Economy Ministry said the accumulated budget deficit was 967.1 billion pesetas, or 1.2 percent of GDP.

According to the report, Folgado said on a cash basis the deficit in the first half of 1997 fell by more than 15 percent year-on-year. In June alone the deficit fell 29.2 percent against the year-ago month, it added.
